digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center parent field outbound sync
propositions: test_outbound_clear_parent_round_trips fails because it attempts to clear a sub-task parent via the parent field, which Data Center does not support; the Epic Link path is reachable as an alternative.
Whether {epic_link_field_id: null} successfully clears the epic link on DC 8.17.1 is untested and must be probed before re-homing the cell to prevent shipping another mutation-proven defect.
The probe (deterministic REST calls with no LLM agent) must land on main before being dispatchable in CI due to GitHub's workflow_dispatch branch constraint.
set_parent's non-sub-task branch lacks read-back verification; if epic link clear silently no-ops, the failure is invisible today.

Two test cases (outbound-set and inbound-set subtask parent) represent distinct platform limitations and should be segregated: outbound-set should be marked xfail(strict=True) and inbound-set re-targeted to adoption.
